scope: Complete inventory of named systems found in this benchmark pass. Fresh local results and vendor-published evidence are kept separate.
strongest_defensible_story: CodexZero Standard preserved 18/18 strict micro tasks and reduced paired provider tokens 17.1% and weighted cost 20.2% versus stock.
The independently repeated Max Savings alias preserved 18/18 strict tasks and reduced paired provider tokens 13.7% and weighted cost 20.6%.
On three high-reasoning DeepSWE tasks, the legacy lean adapter matched stock's 2/3 resolves and exact feature/regression totals while using 32.5% fewer provider tokens and 24.3% less modeled cost.
On 108 Terminal-Bench cells, Safe matched stock's 29/36 task passes with 14.6% fewer tokens and 7.4% less modeled cost.
The result is reliability-first savings: lower cost without relaxing the exact verifier, not the largest isolated compression ratio in every workload.

design.failure_policy: All completed model outcomes remain in the denominator.
